messages.author: 12803b9b5c8793cd
messages.subject: Can not install rsconnect on a Windows 7 computer
parts:
I've been trying to install rsconnect and failing.  Below is the log:

> devtools::install_github('rstudio/rsconnect')
Downloading GitHub repo rstudio/rsconnect@master
from URL https://api.github.com/repos/rstudio/rsconnect/zipball/master
Installing rsconnect
"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/bin/x64/R" --no-site-file --no-environ --no-save  \
  --no-restore CMD INSTALL  \
  "C:/Users/wlazarus/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpsfZt8N/devtools59c4b07231a/rstudio-rsconnect-202c93b"  \
  --library="\\files.umn.edu/cfans/CFANS-Users/wlazarus/Documents/R/win-library/3.2"  \
  --install-tests

* installing *source* package 'rsconnect' ...
** R
** inst
** tests
** preparing package for lazy loading
** help
*** installing help indices
** building package indices
** testing if installed package can be loaded
*** arch - i386
Warning in library(pkg_name, lib.loc = lib, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE) :
  there is no package called 'rsconnect'
Error: loading failed
Execution halted
*** arch - x64
Warning in library(pkg_name, lib.loc = lib, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE) :
  there is no package called 'rsconnect'
Error: loading failed
Execution halted
ERROR: loading failed for 'i386', 'x64'
* removing '\\files.umn.edu/cfans/CFANS-Users/wlazarus/Documents/R/win-library/3.2/rsconnect'
Error: Command failed (1)

Any idea what the problem is?

Thanks.
Bill Lazarus

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Can not install rsconnect on a Windows 7 computer
parts:
I would recommend moving your R library off of a shared volume (network drive) on to your local computer (C:\). I think you can find instructions for this by googling.

-Andy
